in_sanskrit.name: गंगाधरिनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who carries Ganga (river) on her head.

in_marathi.name: Gangaadharini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess carrying Ganga River
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangaadharini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gangaadharini is the name of the goddess Parvati, who holds the river Ganga on her head. The name signifies the power and nurturing capacity of a woman, as the goddess carries the life-giving river on her head.
